17. Electronic Communication

Text Messages and Phone Calls. If you choose to provide a telephone number to Costco and enroll in Costco’s text or SMS messaging or phone call programs, you may receive SMS and text messages (“Text Messages”) or phone calls. Text Messages and phone calls may include recurring and nonrecurring messaging related to events, special offers, or other Costco-related news and other information that we think will be of interest to you. Text Message and phone call frequency will vary, and Costco reserves the right to alter the frequency and total number of Text Messages and phone calls at any time. Costco also reserves the right to change the phone number it uses for Text Messages and phone calls. Consent to receive automated Text Messages or phone calls is not a condition of any purchase. Message, data, and minute rates may apply.

Not all mobile devices or handsets may be supported and our messages may not be deliverable in all areas. Costco, our service providers, and the mobile carriers supported by the Services are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. We will not share information gathered through text messages with third parties for their marketing purposes unless we have your consent.

You may opt out of receiving Text Messages at any time by replying to a Text Message with the keyword STOP, QUIT, END, REVOKE, OPT OUT, CANCEL, or UNSUBSCRIBE. After texting STOP, QUIT, END, REVOKE, OPT OUT, CANCEL, or UNSUBSCRIBE to our short code, you will receive one additional message confirming that your request has been processed. You acknowledge that our text message platform may not recognize and respond to unsubscribe requests that do not consist of the STOP, QUIT, END, REVOKE, OPT OUT, CANCEL, or UNSUBSCRIBE keyword commands. If you have unsubscribed from one of our Text Message programs, you may continue to receive Text Messages from us through any other programs you have joined until you separately unsubscribe from those programs as well.

Text the keyword HELP to our shortcode to receive customer care contact information. If you are experiencing any problems, please contact us using the information in Section 21.

Consent to Electronic Communication. When you visit the Services, chat with us or send email or Text Messages to us, you are communicating with us electronically. You consent to receive communications from us electronically and agree that we may communicate with you by chat, email, Text Message or by posting a notice on the Services. You agree that we may treat specific actions by you, such as checking boxes to receive email or Text Message updates, sending us an email or Text Message directly or through the Costco.com site, providing an email address or phone number in a chat conversation, or leaving a telephone message or Text Message with an email address for customer service to respond to a query about your account, as a request that we communicate personal financial or medical information with you by unencrypted email or Text Message. You acknowledge and agree that unencrypted email sent over the Internet and Text Messages are not secure and may be read by others, and you agree that when you request that we send you email or Text Message you are authorizing us to transmit and disclose your information (including your personal financial or medical information) from time to time in an unencrypted manner. You further acknowledge that emails and Text Messages sent with this information are not stored in a secure manner. Your options, including your right to opt-out of receiving certain kinds of emails from us, are further described in Your Privacy Rights and in our Notice of Privacy Practices: Pharmacies & Health Care Centers.

However, Costco has disclaimed all warranties of any kind with respect to the App, and therefore, there are no warranties applicable to the App.

Product Claims. You and Costco acknowledge that as between Apple and Costco, Costco, not Apple, is responsible for addressing any claims relating to the iOS App or your possession and/or use of the iOS App, including (a) product liability claims, (b) any claim that the iOS App fails to conform to any applicable legal or regulatory requirement, and (c) claims arising under consumer protection or similar legislation.

Developer Name and Address. Any questions, complaints, or claims with respect to the iOS App should be directed to Costco using the contact information provided in Section 21.

Third-Party Terms of Agreement. You will comply with any applicable third-party terms when using the Services.

Third-Party Beneficiary. Apple and its subsidiaries are third-party beneficiaries of these Site Terms, and upon your acceptance of these Site Terms, Apple will have the right (and will be deemed to have accepted the right) to enforce these Site Terms against you as a third-party beneficiary thereof.

Part 2 Terms of Sale

By browsing or purchasing a Product through the Services, you agree to the terms set forth in this Part 2 (the “Terms of Sale”). These Terms of Sale are part of the Site Terms, and the entire Site Terms apply to any transactions you enter into through the Services.

23. Eligibility and Restrictions

To complete a purchase on the Services, you must have a valid shipping address within a country that can be selected as part of the checkout process on the Services (the “Territory”). We make no promise that Products available on the Services are appropriate or available for use in locations outside the Territory.

The Products may not be authorized for resale. We may place a limit on the quantities that may be purchased per order, per account, per payment card, per person, per membership, or per household. We reserve the right, without prior notice, to refuse service to any customer or reject any order at any time and refund any money you have paid for such order.

24. Product Listings

The Services may make available listings, descriptions, and images of Products, as well as references and links to Products and coupons or discounts for Products (“Listings”). The availability through the Services of a Listing for a Product does not imply our endorsement of the Product or our affiliation with the provider of such Product. We attempt to ensure that Listings are complete, accurate, and current, but, despite our efforts, Listings may occasionally be inaccurate, incomplete, or out of date. We make no representations as to the completeness, accuracy, reliability, validity, or timeliness of such Listings (including any features, specifications, and prices contained therein). Such Listings and the availability of any Product (including the validity of any coupon or discount) are subject to change at any time without notice. Certain weights, measures, and similar descriptions are approximate and are for convenience only. We make reasonable efforts to accurately display the attributes of Products, including the applicable colors; however, the actual colors you see will depend on the device you’re using to access the Services, and we cannot guarantee that your device will accurately display such colors. We obtain Listing information from third parties and the information may vary from time to time. Please carefully read all labels on the Product package you receive prior to the use or consumption of any Product.

25. Payment Terms

Prices

Unless otherwise specified in the Listing, prices shown on the Services exclude all taxes, charges for shipping and handling, and non-member surcharge, if applicable. Taxes and shipping and handling costs (and non-member surcharge, if applicable) will be added to the amount of your purchase and itemized on the checkout page. You will have an opportunity to review these costs before you confirm your purchase. All prices on the Services are subject to change at any time without notice.

Payment

If you wish to make a transaction, you may be asked to supply certain relevant information, such as your payment card number and its expiration date, your billing address, and your shipping information, to us or our payment processors. Only valid credit cards or other payment methods acceptable to us may be used and all refunds will be credited to the same card or, in our discretion, another payment method (such as a Costco Shop Card). By submitting an order, you represent and warrant that you are authorized to use the designated card or payment method and you authorize us to charge the order (including taxes, shipping, handling and any other amounts described on the Services) to that card or other payment method. If the card (or other payment method) cannot be verified, is invalid, or is not otherwise acceptable, your order may be suspended or canceled automatically. You will keep all payment cards or other payment method information that you choose to save in your account on the Services current, and you authorize us to submit charges for processing even if the card (or other method) has expired or changed by the time we submit it. You must resolve any problem we encounter in order to proceed with your order. You will pay all charges incurred by you or on your behalf through the Services, at the prices in effect when such charges are incurred, including all taxes and shipping and handling charges applicable to your transactions. In the event legal action is necessary to collect on balances due, you will reimburse us and our vendors or agents for all expenses incurred to recover sums due, including attorneys’ fees and other legal expenses.

Mobile Payments

Our Apps may permit you to link a payment method Costco authorizes for use with your digital membership card. If you do so, you may utilize the App to make payments at Costco warehouse locations in the U.S., including Puerto Rico. When you scan your digital membership card at checkout, you may be permitted to charge your transaction to your saved payment method. However, mobile payments may not always be accepted.

26. Order Confirmation; Acceptance.

You will have the opportunity to review and confirm your order, including delivery address, payment method, and other details of your order. You may not be permitted to change your order once it has been placed. We will display or send a notice when we ultimately accept your order, and our acceptance will be complete at the time we display or send the formal acceptance notice. We may not accept or ship your order until we receive payment.

27. Shipping & Handling; No Export by You

You agree to pay all charges that may be incurred by you or on your behalf throughout the Sites at the price(s) in effect when such charges are incurred, including (without limitation) all shipping, handling, delivery, and other charges or fees. In addition, you remain responsible for any taxes that may be applicable to you. These charges and fees will be quoted at checkout. Products and/or Services will be shipped/provided according to the directions you provided during checkout.

Some Products and Services have restricted delivery/availability. The checkout page will confirm whether any Product cannot be shipped to your area, but you must confirm whether a Service is available in your area before placing an order. We reserve the right to change delivery and Services availability and restrictions from time to time and without prior notice.

When you ask us to ship to a Costco location for pick-up, shipping may be without additional charge. However, some exclusions may apply, we reserve the right to add shipping, delivery, handling, and/or other charges or fees, which will be quoted during checkout. Any shipping, delivery, handling and/or charges and fees may or may not reflect actual costs. Some Products may be available at Costco locations. Prices may vary.

In some cases, the delivery method is pre-determined based on the item. To determine if specific delivery methods are predetermined for a particular item, check the Shipping and Returns section of the product page. Delivery methods will also be displayed on the checkout page. We reserve the right to increase, decrease, add or eliminate applicable delivery methods, and/or applicable charges or fees from time to time and without prior notice.

If your order requires shipping or delivery (including orders shipped to a Costco location for pick-up), the order is a shipment contract, and as a result, risk of loss and title for Products pass to you upon delivery of the Products to the carrier. For pick-up orders fulfilled directly from existing warehouse inventory, risk of loss and title pass to you when you pick up the Products.

Any shipping times shown on the Services are estimates only – actual delivery dates may vary.

You agree that you will not obtain or direct shipment of Product for export.

28. Digital Products

Certain Products may be digital applications or digital codes for accessing third-party services (“Digital Products”). When you purchase a Digital Product, Costco may provide you with the opportunity to download the Digital Product via a third-party delivery platform or may provide you with other instructions for how to access the Digital Product. While Costco may, as a convenience, make Digital Products available for re-download, Costco does not guarantee that you will always be able to re-download or re-access previously purchased Digital Products. It is your responsibility to back up Digital Products you have purchased.

Digital Products are licensed, and not sold, to you. The third party that provides a Digital Product to us for distribution is the "Publisher" of the Digital Product. Your use of a Digital Product will be governed by the terms and conditions of an end-user license agreement between you and the Publisher or other licensor of the Digital Products. Access to Digital Products may be for a limited period, as indicated on the applicable Listing, and you may need to enroll in a recurring subscription with the Publisher for access beyond that period. To use or access a Digital Product, you may also need to have or create an account with the applicable Publisher or other third party. Any information you provide to the Publisher or other third party will be subject to the Publisher's or third party's privacy policy or similar terms.

29. Changes, Misprints, Errors, Delays and Cancellations

Subject to applicable law, we: (a) reserve the right to change the goods and services advertised or offered for sale through the Services, the prices or specifications of such goods and services, and any promotional offers and any other Site Materials at any time and from time to time without any notice or liability to you or any other person; (b) cannot guarantee that goods or services advertised or offered for sale on the Services will be available when ordered or thereafter; (c) reserve the right to limit quantities sold or made available for sale; (d) do not warrant that Listings (including product descriptions or photographs) are accurate, complete, reliable, current or error-free; and (e) reserve the right to delay, cancel, terminate or not process orders (including accepted orders). If we do not process an order, we will advise you that the order has been cancelled and will either not charge you or will apply credit to the payment type used in the order. Some jurisdictions may not allow the exclusions and disclaimers of certain implied warranties, so some of the provisions of this section may not apply to you.

30. Returns and Exchanges of Products

Costco has a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee on every Product we sell, and will refund your purchase price subject to the limits stated in the Returns Policy.
